# Turnip stew

Type: Food | Internal ID: TurnipStew | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Boar meat x1, Turnip x3 | Max Health: 18 | Max Stamina: 55 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 2 hp/tick

# Introduction

Turnip stew is a Swamp-tier food.

## Recipe

Turnip stew is produced at a level 2 Cauldron with:
• 1 Boar meat
• 3 Turnip

### Crafting

• Swamp dweller's delight

## Notes

• Turnip stew provides the highest stamina gain in the Swamps at 55.
